values.note: Non-serviced C$25 a night, 15-amp C$30, 30-amp C$35; monthly 25% less; a seasonal site at the south park site C$1,500. Park entry C$10 a day unless the camper has a season sticker (C$50 on the town's 2022 fee list).

note: Regional park 2 km south of Hudson Bay off Hwy 9, beside the junction of the Fir, Red Deer and Etomami rivers, with a covered camp kitchen, nature trails, ball diamonds and a 9-hole golf course. The park also runs a small campground at Ruby Lake, 15 km north. --Claude
summary: Keep (regional park). 36 electric sites (23 at 30/15 A, 13 at 15 A) in two loops + 6 tent pads; C$25-35 + C$10/day entry; phone booking; season May 10 - Sep 30 (was 05-15..09-15). Not waterfront kept. Pin fine (north loop). Google 4.8 (35). Ruby Lake (9 sites, 15 km N) is a separate campground not in the DB.
flags: SPLIT/LEAD: Ruby Lake Recreation Site, part of the same regional park but 15 km north of town east of Hwy 9 - its own campground: '2-30amp sites, 2-15amp sites, and 5 unserviced sites', beach, boat launch, seasonal camping C$500 (town page); map https://townofhudsonbay.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Hudson-Bay-Ruby-Lake-Site.pdf. Not in campgrounds.json. The stored note named it; it is a separate place, so the note now just mentions it. Booking is the same phone line.

LONG-STAY (local): seasonal sites are offered at the south site (C$1,500) and a monthly rate (25% off), but no count of seasonal sites is posted; nightly share not measurable. The 36-site map shows ordinary numbered loops, and no wording discourages nightly guests.
GOOGLE: 'Hudson Bay Regional Park' 4.8 (35 reviews), phone 306-865-4144.

FEES: the town page's fee table is headed 'Camping Fees for 2022' but its nightly figures match Saskatchewan Regional Parks' current page (C$25/30/35); source given as the regional-parks page (© 2026, '2026 Regional Park Guide'). No GST statement either way.
HOOKUPS: water at sites unclear - the town page lists 'Water Hook Ups' under fees without a price and the regional-parks amenity list includes 'Camping (Electricity and Water)'; not written.
PIN: stored 52.82820,-102.37670 sits by the north loop (sites 1-23) west of Hwy 9. Keep. The regional-parks GPS point 52.82534,-102.37321 is ~400 m SE, at the entrance/office on Hwy 9.
WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' kept - the Fir River bends west of the north loop behind continuous forest (map shows the river 100 m+ from the sites).
INCLUSION_EVIDENCE: fine; optionally add the 2026 site map ('two loops, 23 + 13 electric sites').
